title: Project Asma: reproducible investigation of a primary platinum-refractory HGSOC protein signature
description: Research scaffold (not clinical decision support) to reproduce and stress-test the Chowdhury et al. Cell 2023 primary platinum-refractory HGSOC protein signature. Contains labelled claims (CLAIMS.md), a paper scaffold (paper/manuscript.md), aggregate registries from bounded public-source audits, and pinned software verified on synthetic and fixture inputs only. Upstream data: PDC studies PDC000357-PDC000362 (CC BY 4.0); NLM MMC1/MMC4 supplemental workbooks (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, not redistributed). One executed preliminary check records discovery AUROC 0.8088507878 versus printed 0.83 (tolerance 0.02 not met) as a reproduction discrepancy under investigation. Licences: code MIT, text/site CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE); third-party study content see NOTICE. AI assistance documented in CONTRIBUTORS.md. Not peer reviewed.
notes: Zenodo GitHub integration accepts one licence field; MIT for code is stated in LICENSE and CITATION.cff. Match CITATION.cff title, authors, and version on first Zenodo release. Preferred scientific citation remains Chowdhury et al. Cell 2023 doi:10.1016/j.cell.2023.07.004 for the original signature.
